text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Bamboo Memory and Yaeno
Muteki while
I'm walking by the river
one day.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Okay! Are you ready, Yaeno?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes! Come at me however you want!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory takes her bamboo
blade in
hand... and holds it ready above
her head! Could
this be a duel?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: KIYAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HYAH!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Was that an unarmed technique?!
That was
amazing! Absolutely incredible!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Yaeno and I are just doing
some
martial arts training!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
She spars with me like this every so
often! Kendo
really keeps you sharp and
on your toes!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That's right. And because we've both
been
practicing martial arts since we
were young, we
have a lot in common.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I consider Bamboo a close friend. When
we train
together, I feel we really
embody the meaning of
the phrase,
"birds of a feather."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We're like two feathers in a pod!
Right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo's blunder aside, I decide to
watch them
as they practice. After some
time, just as we're
about to leave...

text_block_list.name: Kitten
text_block_list.text: Meow. Meooow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We follow the sound to a kitten pacing
in front of
a small waterway. It seems
unable to commit to a
course of action.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Th-that's not safe! What if it falls
in?! It
could drown! I'll save y—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: No! Don't touch it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo?! But why not?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Look at the other side. See that other
cat? It's
been keeping watch for a while
now.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That must be its mother. She's already
crossed,
and now she's trying to teach
her kitten how to
jump.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If we get in the way, the kitten won't
learn an
important skill it needs to
survive! The best thing
to do is to suck it
up, stay back, and watch.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
B-but... even so, shouldn't we get them
to
practice somewhere a bit more safe?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This is the challenge the cat gave its
kitten. I
believe the kitten will overcome
this obstacle and
grow from it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Besides... even if it doesn't work out,
there's
nothing to worry about!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We're watching, after all! It's not like
we're not
going to save it if it does
happen to fall in!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh! F-fine! I get it! It's tearing me
up inside...
but I believe the kitten can
do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The kitten successfully leaps over the
water and
reunites with its mother!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! Thank goodness! And look how
proud the
kitten looks! It's so precious!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You were right. The best thing to do was
to just
keep an eye on them... Your
intuition is truly
admirable.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I don't know about all that... When I was
growing
up, my mom used to tell me all
kinds of stories
with lessons in
them—things like how it's not
always
best to do everything for someone!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
How'd it go again? Um... "Teach a fish to
cook,
and it'll eat forever."
...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The saying isn't quite right, but her
judgment
does seem to have helped the
kitten get one step
closer to
independence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The saying isn't quite right, but her
judgment
does seem to have helped the
kitten get one step
closer to
independence.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It did great! That gap is twice its
size! I could
learn a thing or two!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's it! We should follow the kitten's
example
and take on a huge challenge!
How about we
climb up that pillar we
saw earlier at the bridge?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We need to become braver as
well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, it was nice to observe the
differences
between these two fairly
similar Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Good thinking! Do we have anything
that might
work as a cat toy?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh! The mother cat is grooming the
kitten! It's
like she's saying, "Good job!"
Oooh! I just want to
protect the both of
them!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Earth to Yaeno! Are you listening?
You're getting
all mother hen on us
again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, it was nice to observe the
differences
between these two kindred
spirits.
